title: System Architecture Overview
description: Overview of Laxmi Enterprise monorepo layout comprising React Supervisor/Admin web apps, FastAPI backend, and shared libraries.

title: FastAPI Server Application Entry
description: Backend entry point configuring FastAPI app, CORS middleware, API route routers, and MongoDB connection lifespan.

title: API Routing & Authentication
description: REST endpoints handling user login authentication, JWT token validation, employee data, and vehicle assignment management.

title: Data Models & Persistence
description: MongoDB asynchronous database connection pool and Pydantic schemas for attendance records and employee tracking.

title: Supervisor Frontend Application
description: Main supervisor frontend dashboard managing daily employee attendance tracking and vehicle loading assignments.

title: Vehicle Assignment & Capacity Table
description: Interactive table managing vehicle assignments, driver/chalan capacity rule checks, and real-time utilization progress bars.

title: Shared Monorepo Libraries
description: Shared React hooks (`useEmployees`, `useVehicles`) and REST API client services consumed by supervisor and admin frontends.
